entries.title: Cards can show a short demo of how a change works
entries.body: When a change is about how something moves or responds - a drag, a keyboard journey, a loading state - a crewmate's card can now show a short demo instead of still pictures. The card shows a still from it with a Play button and its length; Play opens it in the large viewer, where it plays once and you can pause, scrub and replay. Nothing plays on its own.

picture.alt: A crewmate's merge card with a demo's still and a Play button that says it lasts 3 seconds under After
